functions.name: animation_exporter.add_sequence
functions.description: Register a new animation sequence for export.

rig.description: FRAG rig. Uses selection if None.

output_path.description: Full output path for FBX. Auto-generates if None.

start_at_zero.description: Animation starts at frame 0 when exported

root_to_origin.description: Root moves to origin when exported

functions.name: animation_exporter.create_sequence_from_scene
functions.description: Auto-create an animation sequence using scene filename and timeline range.

rig.description: The FRAG rig to create the sequence for.

sequence_name.description: Optional name override. If None, derives from scene filename.

functions.name: animation_exporter.export_all_animations
functions.description: Batch export all registered animation sequences for selected rigs.

rigs.description: List of FRAG rigs. Uses selection if None.

skip_sequences.description: List of sequence paths/names to skip

functions.name: animation_exporter.export_animation
functions.description: Export a single animation sequence to FBX. Uses selected rig if none provided.

rig.description: FRAG rig to export. Uses selection if None.

sequence_name.description: Name of sequence to export (supports fuzzy matching)

sequence_path.description: Full path to sequence. Takes priority over name.

frame_range.description: [start_frame, end_frame]. Uses sequence range if None.

start_at_zero.description: Shift animation to start at frame 0

root_to_origin.description: Move root to origin during export

functions.name: animation_exporter.export_selected_rig_animations
functions.description: Quick export all animations for selected rigs.

functions.name: animation_exporter.find_sequence_by_name
functions.description: Find a sequence by name with optional fuzzy matching.

rig.description: The FRAG rig to search within. If None, searches all rigs.

fuzzy.description: Whether to use fuzzy matching (default True).

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_current_frame_range
functions.description: Get the current timeline frame range in Maya.

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_scene_rigs
functions.description: Get all FRAG rigs in the current Maya scene. Returns list of rig info dicts with name, asset_id, has_sequences, and sequence_count.

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_selected_rig
functions.description: Get a single FRAG rig from the current Maya selection.

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_selected_rig_and_sequence
functions.description: Smart detection of rig and sequence from selection and timeline.

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_selected_rigs
functions.description: Get all FRAG rigs from the current Maya selection.

functions.name: animation_exporter.get_sequence_info
functions.description: Get detailed information about a specific sequence.

rig.description: FRAG rig. Uses selection if None.

sequence_path.description: Path of sequence. Takes priority over name.

functions.name: animation_exporter.list_sequences
functions.description: Get all registered animation sequences for a rig or all rigs.

rig.description: FRAG rig to query. Lists all if None.

functions.name: animation_exporter.remove_sequence
functions.description: Remove a sequence from the export system (does not delete FBX file).

rig.description: FRAG rig. Uses selection if None.

functions.name: animation_exporter.smart_export
functions.description: AI-friendly animation export that handles all setup automatically. Finds rigs (from selection or scene), creates sequences if needed (with ANIM_ prefix from scene filename), and exports to FBX. If multiple rigs exist and none selected, returns list of available rigs for user to choose.

rigs.description: Optional list of rig names to export. Uses selection or scene search if None.

sequence_name.description: Optional name for auto-created sequence. Prefixed with ANIM_ if not already. Derives from scene filename if None.

force_create_sequence.description: If true, creates new sequence even if sequences exist.

rig.description: The FRAG rig owning the sequence. If None, uses selected rig.

sequence_name.description: Name of sequence to update (supports fuzzy matching).

sequence_path.description: Path of sequence to update. Takes priority over sequence_name.
